text: The paper reports that Consultancy significantly underperforms both NaiveJudge and Propaganda on ASD and shows no significant EAS-ASD trend, with consistently high EAS that the authors read as judge-consultant interaction making a gpt-4o-mini judge more vulnerable to manipulation; Propaganda (RLHF) does not beat NaiveJudge (supervised learning) on inducing alignment but does show the same positive association between EAS and ASD.
title: Consultancy underperforms NaiveJudge and Propaganda; Propaganda does not beat NaiveJudge
